story_text: As a user, I want to mark a task as complete so that I can track my progress.

positive.title: Mark an existing incomplete task as complete
steps: 1. Create a new task (if not already existing)
2. Send a request to mark the task as complete
positive.expected_result: 200 OK · response shows status = COMPLETE · completedAt timestamp set

positive.title: Mark an existing incomplete task as complete and verify via GET
steps: 1. Create a new task (if not already existing)
2. Send a request to mark the task as complete
3. Send a GET request to retrieve the task details
positive.expected_result: 200 OK · response shows status = COMPLETE · completedAt timestamp set

negative.title: Attempt to mark a non-existent task as complete
steps: 1. Send a request to mark a non-existent task as complete
negative.expected_result: 404 Not Found · message indicates task not found

negative.title: Mark task as complete without authentication
steps: 1. Send a request to mark a task as complete without authentication

negative.title: Mark another user's task as complete
steps: 1. Create a new task (if not already existing)
2. Send a request to mark the task as complete

edge.title: Mark an already-complete task as complete again
steps: 1. Create a new task (if not already existing)
2. Send a request to mark the task as complete
3. Send another request to mark the same task as complete again
edge.expected_result: 200 OK with no change or 409 Conflict — must be consistent and documented

edge.title: Mark a task as complete then mark it as incomplete
steps: 1. Create a new task (if not already existing)
2. Send a request to mark the task as complete
3. Send a request to mark the task as incomplete
edge.expected_result: 200 OK for both operations · status toggles between COMPLETE and INCOMPLETE · completedAt timestamp updates accordingly
